nomorezombies.config.title: NoMoreZombies Config
nomorezombies.config.sst.comment.waveSou:
Whether the per-wave spawn sound plays on Alien Arcadium
Depends on the "Wave spawn sound" master switch
Sound ID and pitch are set below

Whether the per-wave spawn sound plays on Dead End
Depends on the "Wave spawn sound" master switch
Sound ID and pitch are set below

Whether the per-wave spawn sound plays on Bad Blood
Depends on the "Wave spawn sound" master switch
Sound ID and pitch are set below

Whether the per-wave spawn sound plays on Prison
Depends on the "Wave spawn sound" master switch
Sound ID and pitch are set below
nomorezombies.config.sst.comment.precede:
Sound ID played on every wave except the last
Defaults to the note block pling
(minecraft:block.note_block.pling)
Any valid Minecraft sound ID works
Non-Minecraft IDs (local audio files) do not

Pitch of the normal wave spawn sound
Range: 0.0~2.0
nomorezombies.config.sst.comment.lastWav:
Sound ID played when a round's last wave spawns
Defaults to the experience orb pickup
(minecraft:entity.experience_orb.pickup)
Any valid Minecraft sound ID works
Non-Minecraft IDs (local audio files) do not

Pitch of the last-wave spawn sound
Range: 0.0~2.0
nomorezombies.config.sst.comment.finalWa:
Toggles the 3-2-1 countdown before each round's last wave
When on, the countdown fires once per second
before the last wave
nomorezombies.config.sst.comment.countDo:
Sound ID played during the 3-2-1 countdown
Defaults to the note block pling
(minecraft:block.note_block.pling)
Any valid Minecraft sound ID works
Non-Minecraft IDs (local audio files) do not

Pitch of the countdown sound
Range: 0.0~2.0
nomorezombies.config.sst.comment.colorAl:
Marks waves that spawn the Old One or a Giant
Green for Old One,purple for Giant,red for Rainbow Giant
nomorezombies.config.powerup.comment.pow:
Announces the next refresh round and type
for every committed powerup at each round's start
nomorezombies.config.powerup.comment.ale:
Where powerup drop and prediction alerts go
Three tiers: Self/Party (/pc)/Public (/ac)
Self is visible only on this client
Party is visible to party members after joining a Party
Public is visible to everyone
but repeated broadcasts get rate-limited by Hypixel
nomorezombies.config.aaautocommand.comme:
Where AA auto command messages go
Three tiers: Self/Party (/pc)/Public (/ac)
Self is visible only on this client
Party is visible to party members after joining a Party
Public is visible to everyone
but repeated broadcasts get rate-limited by Hypixel

Template for the per-round auto command message
Placeholders are filled in at runtime:
{round}=round number
{point}=recommended points
{boss}=boss (Giant/Old One/Giant+Old One/None)
{difficulty}=difficulty (I~V)
Empty or unknown variables fall back to the default
nomorezombies.config.record.comment.roun:
How often round stats are broadcast
Three tiers: every round/every 5 rounds/every 10 rounds
nomorezombies.config.hide.comment.hideGo:
Hides "+N Gold" style messages in chat
Keeps the screen clear of money spam
nomorezombies.config.hide.comment.hideWi:
Hides every chat message in a window repair's lifecycle
Keeps the screen clear of repair spam
nomorezombies.config.hide.comment.hideHi:
Hides "X hit the target!" style chat messages
(Though really,who needs them)
nomorezombies.config.hide.comment.hideLu:
Hides chat messages related to opening lucky chests
(After this,an item can walk off
and you will not even know)
nomorezombies.config.hide.comment.hideOp:
Hides Title messages about you or a teammate
unlocking a new area
nomorezombies.config.hide.comment.hidePl: Hides join and leave messages for players
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.waveSou:
Master switch for all wave-related sounds
Covers the normal wave cue and the final-wave countdown
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.recordE:
Master switch for round stats broadcasts
When on, kills/duration/RKPM are announced
at the configured frequency
When off, every round broadcast goes silent
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.utility:
Master switch for all HUDs
Overrides every per-HUD switch
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.teammat:
Draws ESP boxes on teammates in the current game
Red while fighting,yellow while downed
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.zombieE:
Draws ESP boxes on every hostile
Green by default
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.entityH: Draws a text health bar above hostiles
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.damageN:
A digit pops off an entity's head
when it loses or regains health
Red for damage,green for healing
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.bossHea:
Draws boss health bars with a special palette
Purple by default,then yellow/orange/red as health drops
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.bossEsp:
Draws boss ESP with a special palette
Orange by default
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.teammat:
How teammate ESP draws
Normal: depth-tested as usual
Through walls: visible behind obstacles
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.zombieE:
How zombie ESP draws
Normal: depth-tested as usual
Through walls: visible behind obstacles
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.powerup:
How powerup ESP draws
Normal: depth-tested as usual
Through walls: visible behind obstacles
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.healthB:
How the zombie health bar draws
Normal: depth-tested as usual
Through walls: visible behind obstacles
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.damageN:
How damage numbers draw
Normal: depth-tested as usual
Through walls: visible behind obstacles
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.through:
How far through-wall rendering reaches,in blocks
Beyond it, entities stop rendering through walls
Applies to ESP, health bars and damage numbers
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.playerI:
Does not render player entities at point-blank range
Handy for LS on Alien Arcadium
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.hideBos:
Stops the vanilla boss bar at the top of the screen
from drawing
Avoids overlapping the custom HUD
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.rightCl:
Right-click fires only, no interactions
Covers doors, lucky chests, team machines, perks, and the rest
Unlike ZHF, it will not get you banned
ZHF spoofs packets
this feature refuses the right-click at the client layer
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.noParti:
Removes every client-side particle
Gunfire, guardian attacks, Inferno footstep drops, and more
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.fireOve:
Removes the screen fire overlay while you burn
Very useful when not running a low-fire resource pack
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.aaAutoC:
Alien Arcadium auto command
Reads a fixed data table to recommend points
and predict bosses
Also rates each round's difficulty so you can prepare ahead
Then you can start thinking about what to eat on round x0
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.zoomEna:
Temporarily magnifies the view
when the zoom key is pressed in-game
Anyone familiar with Optifine or Zoomify will recognize it
Detailed behaviour is configurable below
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.alwaysS:
Stays sneaking while this is on
Might help with LS on Alien Arcadium
Normally will not get you banned
It only mimics a real Shift press on the client

Stays sprinting while this is on
Anyone who has used a PvP client knows
how much this matters
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.gammaOv:
Roughly "permanent night vision"
Still a client-side change
only the ambient brightness is altered
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.freeCam:
Enables a free-camera view in-game
Anyone who has used Tweakeroo will recognize it
In Zombies it lets you watch teammates while you are downed
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.openHud:
Opens the HUD editor
Lets you control on-screen HUD behaviour
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.apiKey:
Hypixel API Key used for player data queries
Stored encrypted locally
Decrypted only inside the query logic
Static analysis cannot break it
Get one free at https://developer.hypixel.net
Re-enter it after switching devices
nomorezombies.config.qol.comment.openQue:
Opens the player data query screen
Free query looks up any player anywhere
In-game query only runs once a Zombies game has started
nomorezombies.config.zoom.comment.zoomKe:
Key that triggers the zoom feature
Detailed behaviour is configurable below
nomorezombies.config.zoom.comment.initia:
Default maximum zoom while zoom is enabled
Range: 1.0~10.0
nomorezombies.config.zoom.comment.easing:
Easing curve for the zoom animation
Ease Out Exponential: fast at first, then decelerates
Ease Out Sine: smooth throughout
Linear: constant speed
Instant: no animation, it just cuts
nomorezombies.config.zoom.comment.keyBeh:
Key behaviour for zoom
Hold: zoom while held, restore on release
Toggle: press to zoom, press again to restore
nomorezombies.config.sneak.name.alwaysSn: Allow Sneaking While GUI Is Open
nomorezombies.config.sneak.prettyName.al: Allow Sneaking While GUI Is Open
nomorezombies.config.sneak.comment.alway:
Keeps forced sneaking active inside container screens
Prevents the inventory/team machine screens
from breaking the sneak state
Still a client-side change
Normally will not get you banned
nomorezombies.config.gamma.comment.gamma:
Target brightness used while gamma override is active
Range: 0.0~32.0
nomorezombies.config.freecamera.name.pla: Allow Player Movement During Free Camera
nomorezombies.config.freecamera.prettyNa: Allow Player Movement During Free Camera
How the player body behaves during Free Camera
On: the body keeps walking while the camera flies
parked at a fixed viewpoint
Off: the body is frozen and the camera flies freely
with WASD and the mouse
nomorezombies.config.freecamera.name.pla: Allow Player Inputs During Free Camera
nomorezombies.config.freecamera.prettyNa: Allow Player Inputs During Free Camera
How the player body's inputs behave during Free Camera
On: the body can still act, e.g. shoot and interact
Off: those actions are blocked

Flight speed multiplier for the Free Camera
Range: 0.1~10.0
Hold Ctrl to temporarily accelerate
